source.snippet: I'm currently working on a client project, and I'm running into usage limits with AI coding assistants. I've been using GitHub Copilot and OpenAI Codex/ChatGPT, but the limits are so strict that sometimes I can't use them for 30 minutes or more. Even with a paid ChatGPT subscription, I still hit model usage limits (especially on GPT-5.x), which interrupts my development workflow. I'm looking for a free or open-source alternative that works directly inside VS Code and can do things like: AI code [completion/chat]

problem_statement: Freelance and agency developers on paid AI coding assistant subscriptions (Copilot, ChatGPT) hit hard rate limits mid-project, causing workflow interruptions of 30+ minutes and forcing a search for fallback tooling with no seamless handoff.
target_segment: Freelance software developers and small dev agencies doing client work, already paying for AI coding tools.
notes: Buyer is explicit: paying for ChatGPT subscription and GitHub Copilot yet still blocked. Pain is mid-project workflow disruption on client work (time = money). Opportunity could be a quota-aware IDE extension that transparently fails over across multiple LLM backends (OpenAI, Anthropic, local Ollama) so developers never hit a cold wall. Single signal from one post; signal_strength capped at 2 pending corroboration.
